messages:
maya (partnerships): quick heads-up 3 we need a short, operational intake for SI-led opportunities that includes routing, ownership, and announce criteria. want to avoid manual fights later.
lee (sales): agreed. can we make a default: existing commercial SI relationship = SI ownership; otherwise RDW AE owns?
anya (solutions): that's sensible. add: if SI brings a signed PO/SOW then auto-assign to SI. if it's an intro only, assign to RDW AE and tag SI as collaborator.
oliver (product): also need a gating check for marketplace assets before any public joint announcement: logo, one-pager, single-sentence customer quote.
tess (revops): i'll express this as HubSpot tags + a routing workflow. tags: partner_relationship, proof_of_business, lead_source, account_owner, joint_announce_allowed. sample values: partner_relationship=active|prospect; proof_of_business=po|sow|intro; account_owner=si|rdw; joint_announce_allowed=yes|no.
nate (partner-ops): I'll build a simple intake matrix. columns: partner_relationship, proof_of_business, account_owner_default, route_queue, announce_prereqs.
maya (partnerships): great. need an adjudication flow if AE and SI disagree. propose 48h to resolve, then partner-ops picks.
lee (sales): +1. also add a revenue-share threshold that forces legal to sign off on co-branded statements (>15% revshare).
anya (solutions): small practical note: when SI wants RDW to run the demo, tag demo_host=rdw/si/both so scheduling is clear.
tess (revops): i'll draft the automation rules and share the workflow JSON in Confluence. will include an audit log field for provenance.
nate (partner-ops): i'll create the Confluence page and a tiny checklist for marketing/comms: one-pager, logo, legal ok, comms owner, publish date window. i'll ping this thread.
maya (partnerships): timeline: nate + tess first pass by Thu EOD, oliver will block marketplace publish checks once we have the matrix, and lee will surface any edge cases from the field. thanks team :rocket:
